auditor_note: ayanamsha_id has no enum constraint in the tool schema (free string) and the handler performs no validation against the known vocabulary (lahiri_chitrapaksha, krishnamurti, raman, surya_siddhanta_classical, true_chitra, INVARIANT). An unrecognized value silently returns rows:[], total:0 with NO empty_reason/error disclosing that the ayanamsha itself is unrecognized — indistinguishable from 'this chart genuinely has no dasha periods in the default 10-year window'. Control call with the same chart_id/window and a VALID ayanamsha_id='lahiri_chitrapaksha' (no other params changed) returns total:90 real rows — see ganita_dashas_get__control_valid_ayanamsha.json.
